messages:
Maya: quick sync: need alignment on Q2 initiative + runtime QPS/batching for Atlas enterprise request. p95 SLA <150ms for short-chat. Can eng/runtime/infra commit?

Asher: confirm: Atlas expects p95 SLA. Do we treat p95 across all traffic or sampled? Also need rollout windows.

Maya: p95 across baseline and heavy tail patterns in our benchmark. Launch criteria: p95 < 150ms on >=90% of benchmark scenarios, canary on dedicated pool, documented rollback.

Rachel: runtime plan: KV cache priming + adaptive batching and dynamic token-limit trimming. Fallback to v1 model when cold. Need infra pre-warmed nodes + reserved pools.

Devon: infra: reserved pools require TF changes, quota requests — ~4w provisioning. If opt for <6w timeline, recommend burst-capacity path; will need cost comparison.

Luis: product stance: if provisioning >6w we prefer shipping hosted-first with reduced SLA and plan private/dedicated follow-up.

Sam: security: Atlas requires SOC2 scoping + KMS. Private deployment needs HSM/KMS + audit timeline ~3w. We need eng time to remediate findings.

Maya: owner for rollout policy? Need canary/ramp and auto-fallback when error-rate >1% or latency spike >30%.

Asher: I'll own rollout with Rachel. Proposed ramp: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h with health checks. Add Console kill-switch.

Rachel: health checks planned: latency p95, error-rate, kv-hit-rate, model token latency. Alerts:
- latency p95 > 200ms => immediate rollback
- error-rate >1% => pause traffic
- kv-hit-rate <60% => mark warming

Devon: infra action: add quota alerts and scaling guardrails. Provide infra config sample pls.

Rachel: perf sketch for Atlas baseline: dedicated = 4 x A100-equivalent; burst +2 nodes. Will run perf jobs and post numbers by Thu EOD.

Devon: I'll prepare cost/provisioning plan by Thu. Need expected instance counts to automate scaling config.

Sam: security will draft gating checklist (SOC2 items + KMS integration steps) by Thu. Also request a remediation canary window during rollout.

Maya: decision by Fri EOD: (A) commit to dedicated pool (4w lead) OR (B) ship hosted with degraded SLA and fast follow for private. Product to sign off on tradeoffs.

Luis: I'll escalate budget if dedicated chosen. If hosted path chosen, document SLA differences and customer comms.

Asher: Action items:
- Rachel: perf numbers -> Thu EOD
- Devon: cost & provisioning plan -> Thu EOD
- Sam: security checklist -> Thu EOD
- Maya/Luis: go/no-go decision -> Fri EOD

deploy-bot: no deploys scheduled.

Maya: thanks all. Keep updates here. Ping @Asher @Rachel @Devon if anything slips. :thumbsup:
